message.content: Columbia University is an Ivy League research university located in New York City, United States. Founded in 1754 as King's College, it was renamed Columbia College in 1784 and later became Columbia University in 1896. It is one of the oldest institutions of higher education in the United States and has a strong reputation for academic excellence, research, and public service. The campus is situated on Manhattan’s Morningside Heights neighborhood, covering approximately 36 acres. Columbia offers undergraduate, graduate, and professional programs across a wide range of disciplines through its various schools and colleges, including Columbia College (undergraduate), the School of Engineering and Applied Science, the Graduate School of Arts and Sciences, the School of International and Public Affairs, the School of Journalism, the School of Law, the School of Medicine, the School of Social Work, and the Mailman School of Public Health.
